messages:
emma: hi all, i'm emma, first day. i ran `kubectl get pods -n inference-dev` and got `Forbidden`. onboarding script said my kubeconfig would be set up automatically. who should i ping for access?

jen (devex): welcome @emma! :wave: pinging @sam (infra). quick Q: what's your SSO email and did you run the `redwood-onboard` script?

emma: emma.r@redwood.ai, yes i ran the script. `kubectl config current-context` shows `redwood-dev`.

sam (infra): hey @emma, welcome! sometimes the SSO group sync lags. i'll open a short-lived RoleBinding for `view` in `inference-dev` and confirm group membership. creating ticket now.

ops-bot: INFRA-1500 created by sam: "temp view binding for emma.r in inference-dev". ETA: 10m.

sam (infra): applied. run `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n inference-dev --as emma.r@redwood.ai` then `kubectl get pods -n inference-dev`. if you need port-forward later let me know.

emma: `can-i` returns yes and `kubectl get pods` lists pods. thanks so much!

jen (devex): added a note to onboarding to verify SSO group membership and run `echo $KUBECONFIG` if folks hit Forbidden. congrats on day 1 :tada:"
